exp.desc:
- Posters and ads
- Websites and social

cl.p1: twelve words for a poster at a bus stop where people wait forty seconds on average: that brief kept me busy for two weeks during my traineeship at a creative agency. The campaign ran in four cities last autumn.
cl.p2: After my English degree I spent a year writing websites, ads and social posts for clients from an organic grocer to an engineering firm. I enjoy getting into subjects I knew nothing about. Three samples are attached.

cl.p1: eight years in agencies mean thirty clients, hundreds of taglines and the feeling of only just getting to know a brand when the project ends. I want to write for one brand and shape it over years.
cl.p2: I have conceived and written campaigns for sports, tourism and mobility brands, most recently as creative lead with two designers. I have used your gear on trips in Norway for years, and I think I know how your customers feel when the tent holds in a storm.
